integrity: Analytic proof with independent finite numerical and geometrical reproducibility checks. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the normalized regular rhombic dodecahedron and Haar-uniform central planes; does not evaluate distributions of noncentral sections or arbitrary affine deformations. Historical priority of the special explicit cuboctahedral reciprocal-width law is uncertain because a broadly relevant polyhedral width study was available only by abstract; independent review is outstanding.
title: Three-chamber radial law and exact mean central-section area of the rhombic dodecahedron
